name: follow-the-money
description: Open-source, bring-your-own-API-key tool for exploring publicly disclosed money-in-politics data alongside legislative activity. Shows patterns, not proof.

scripts.pipeline: npm run ingest:fec && npm run ingest:congress && npm run ingest:usaspending && npm run classify && npm run export
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @ftm/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ftm/core && npm run test -w @ftm/ingest
